title: 1994 AHSME Problem 8
statement: In the polygon shown, each side is perpendicular to its adjacent sides, and all \(28\) of the sides are congruent. The perimeter of the polygon is \(56.\) The area of the region bounded by the polygon is

solutions.text: Each side has length \(2.\) Measured in side-length units, the seven horizontal strips have widths \[ 1,3,5,7,5,3,1, \] totaling \(25\) unit squares. Each such square has area \(2^2=4,\) so the polygon’s area is \(25\cdot4=100.\) Thus the correct answer is C.
hints: In units of one side length, split the shape into horizontal strips of widths \(1,3,5,7,5,3,1\)
